title: Puffer and Anchorage Digital Partner to Bring Institutional Settlement Infrastructure to Puffer UniFi
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Cayman Islands, Cayman Islands, September 29th, 2026] Anchorage Digital will serve as Puffer UniFi’s day-one institutional custodian, with the companies collaborating on stablecoin infrastructure, native settlement, and agentic payments Puffer Finance, an Ethereum infrastructure company building Puffer UniFi, today announced a partnership with Anchorage Digital, home to America’s first federally regulated crypto […]
